g.text: - Uploaded video available in 5 min for others' feed (P95)
- A user views their feed - infinite scrolling video feed
- 100 million active users daily - 1 B total users
- 1 million new short videos uploaded daily
- 1 billion daily video watched -> 10^9 per day = 10^4 per sec | peak is 10^7 per sec
- High Availability, global scale, durable videos, low latency for viewing starts streaming in < 100 ms.
